name: imagebridge
description: Host local images and documents through ImageBridge for compatible AI workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Host local images and documents for compatible AI workflows.
interface.longDescription: Upload explicitly selected local images or documents to your own ImageBridge server and return expiring links. The ChatGPT Web extension displays local previews and submits hosted URLs as text; it does not bypass ChatGPT upload limits or make local URLs remotely accessible.
defaultPrompt: Use ImageBridge to host this local image or document when I explicitly ask.
